title: 第1章 梦境控制第2章 我来到了双修宫男人呢
content_zh:
我叫师翌恒，今年28岁，马上就要结束学生生涯，前往玄土星加入双修宫，研究超自然科学。
玄土星人是修炼文明，他们以阴阳之道，驾驭五行之力，感悟天地，追求天人合一。
我相信存在就是道理，也许科学的尽头便是修炼，而修炼到极致，便能窥见宇宙的本源奥秘。
放弃科学，另辟蹊径，踏上修炼之路，实属无奈。
我除了物理好，其他学科一塌糊涂，考零分那是常有的事儿。
特别是语文，好几次都把老师气得住院。
有同学说我是故意隐藏实力，因为100道判断题，我能做到全错，就算闭着眼睛瞎蒙，也不可能有这么高的错误率。
我也曾试着逆向思维，故意把心里的答案改成相反的。
可不管我怎么反转选择，最终写在卷子上的答案，必定还是错的，除非完全不经过思考，随手乱填。
这事儿已经超出了自然科学能解释的范畴，也是我决心走上修炼之路的原因之一。
……
我有个同学叫华珍恋，她其他学科都很优秀，尤其是语文成绩格外突出，可物理却差得离谱，考零分也是常有的事。
老师特意把她调成我的同桌，想让我们互帮互助，彼此取长补短。
她总说我缺乏想象力，活得像一潭死水，只会用冰冷的公式去解构整个世界。
有一次，她让我写一篇短文形容她的美。
我铆足了劲儿发挥“想象力”，写了这么几句：“你瘦得像个猴儿，只是脸上没有毛儿；你鼻子高高像山峰，下面还有俩山洞……”
这话直接把她气转了学，直到高考前才重新回来。
最后，我们俩一起考上了全球最顶尖的大学——寰宇科技大学。
说到成绩，我和她都是满分。
要知道考前最后一次模拟测试，我还考了两个零蛋，当时没人相信我能逆袭拿满分。

恰巧那一年，植入性“脑机接口”开始普及，语言交流再也没有障碍，语文也不再纳入高考科目，不然的话，我根本不可能考满分。
也是在那一年，太阳系内出现了一处虫洞，人类借此发现了第一个外星文明——玄土星文明。
玄土星人那些超越自然的天赋能力，让全人类都意识到，科学或许并不是探索真理的唯一途径。
后来有几位专家来调查我考满分的原因，他们甚至怀疑我被玄土星人附身了。
我实话实说：“我梦到了答案！”
我没说瞎话，除了物理是靠自己的真实水平，其他学科的答案，我真的是在梦里梦到的，而且全是标准答案。
我也是无意中发现自己能控制梦境，只不过这种能力需要付出代价，得让我身上的某个器官永久消失，或是彻底失去功能。
而且梦境也不能随意控制，能控制的范围，全看牺牲的器官有多重要。
我当时就是以四颗智齿和阑尾为代价，换来了在梦中“穿越”到公布标准答案那一天的机会。
其实物理答案我根本不需要梦，可我特意把华珍恋也拉入了我的梦中，让她的物理也考了满分。
高考结束后，她成了我的女朋友，还选了当时的新兴学科——“超自然科学”专业。
我当时还没彻底放弃科学，选的是“物理学”专业。
可物理专业也不都是纯物理相关的课程，其他杂七杂八的科目，让我每次考试都排在最后。
后来为了能考上研究生，我又牺牲了扁桃体和一侧的蛋，彻底转去了“超自然科学”专业。
地球上其实也有不少人修习各种传统功法，只不过很少有人能像玄土星人那样，拥有真正超越自然的能力。
加入“超自然科学”专业后，我开始钻研经络与内息的奥秘，同时修炼起“基础调息”功法。
“基础调息”这门功法，仿佛是人类与生俱来的天赋能力，只要能静心凝神，坚持一段时间，就能感知到体内的内息，会沿着任督二脉、十二经络自然循环。
一开始我没感觉到任何特别之处，但这是专业必修课，我只能一直坚持修炼。
content_en:
My name is Shi Yiheng, I am 28 years old this year, and I will soon end my student career. I will go to Xuantu Xing to join the Double Cultivation Palace to study supernatural science.
The Xuantu people are a cultivating civilization. They use the yin and yang method to control the power of the five elements, understand the heaven and the earth, and pursue the unity of heaven and man.
I believe that existence is truth. Perhaps the end of science is cultivation, and if you practice to the extreme, you can get a glimpse of the origin and mystery of the universe.
It is really helpless to abandon science and find another way to embark on the path of cultivation.
Except for physics, I was terrible at other subjects. It was common for me to get zero marks in exams.
Especially in Chinese, the teacher was so angry that he was hospitalized several times.
Some classmates said that I deliberately hid my strength because I could get all the 100 true-false questions wrong. Even if I closed my eyes, I wouldn't have such a high error rate.
I also tried to think backwards and deliberately changed the answer in my mind to the opposite.
But no matter how I reverse my choices, the answer written on the paper will still be wrong unless I fill it in randomly without thinking at all.
This matter has gone beyond the scope of explanation by natural science, and it is one of the reasons why I decided to embark on the path of cultivation.
…
I have a classmate named Hua Zhenlian. She is excellent in other subjects, especially Chinese, but she is extremely poor in physics. It is common to get zero marks in exams.
The teacher specially made her my deskmate, hoping that we would help each other and learn from each other's strengths.
She always said that I lacked imagination, lived like a pool of stagnant water, and could only use cold formulas to deconstruct the entire world.
Once, she asked me to write a short article describing her beauty.
I tried my best to use my "imagination" and wrote a few sentences: "You are as thin as a monkey, but there is no hair on your face; your nose is as high as a mountain peak, and there are two caves below..."
These words immediately sent her to another school out of anger, and she didn't come back until before the college entrance examination.
Finally, the two of us were admitted to the world's top university - Huanyu University of Science and Technology.
When it comes to grades, both she and I get perfect marks.
You must know that in the last mock test before the exam, I scored two zeros. At that time, no one believed that I could counterattack and get full marks.
It happened that that year, implantable "brain-computer interfaces" began to become popular, there were no longer barriers to language communication, and Chinese was no longer included in the college entrance examination subjects. Otherwise, it would have been impossible for me to get perfect scores.
Also in that year, a wormhole appeared in the solar system, through which humans discovered the first alien civilization, the Xuan Saturn civilization.
The innate abilities of the Xuantu people that transcend nature have made all mankind realize that science may not be the only way to explore the truth.
Later, several experts came to investigate the reason for my perfect score. They even suspected that I was possessed by Xuan Saturn.
I told the truth: "I dreamed about the answer!"
I'm not lying. Except for physics, I relied on my own real level. I really came up with the answers to other subjects in my dreams, and they were all standard answers.
I also accidentally discovered that I can control dreams, but this ability comes at a price, which requires that an organ in my body permanently disappears or completely loses its function.
Moreover, dreams cannot be controlled at will. The scope of control depends entirely on the importance of the sacrificed organ.
I sacrificed my four wisdom teeth and appendix for the opportunity to "travel" in my dream to the day when the standard answer was announced.
In fact, I don’t need a dream at all for physics answers, but I deliberately pulled Hua Zhenlian into my dream so that she could get full marks in physics.
After the college entrance examination, she became my girlfriend and she also majored in "Supernatural Science", an emerging subject at the time.
I had not completely given up on science at that time, so I majored in "Physics".
But physics majors are not all purely physics-related courses. Other miscellaneous subjects made me rank last in every exam.
Later, in order to be admitted to graduate school, I sacrificed my tonsils and an egg on one side.I switched to the "Supernatural Science" major.
In fact, there are many people on the earth who practice various traditional techniques, but very few people have the ability to truly transcend nature like the Xuantu people.
After joining the "Supernatural Science" major, I began to delve into the mysteries of meridians and inner breath, and at the same time practiced the "Basic Breath Regulation" technique.
The "Basic Breath Adjustment" technique seems to be an innate ability of human beings. As long as you can meditate and concentrate for a period of time, you can feel the inner breath in the body and it will naturally circulate along the Ren and Du meridians and the twelve meridians.
I didn't feel anything special at first, but it was a required course for my major, so I had no choice but to keep practicing.
